content:
The former Hollywood Theaters property in Laredo has been sold, and new plans for the site would turn it into an entertainment, retail and restaurant hub, according to the Laredo Morning Times.

Hector Alaniz outlined the plans for the property, the Times reported. The proposal includes a possible conference center and an incoming Twin Peaks restaurant.

The redevelopment is presented as a new entertainment hub for the city, bringing dining, shopping and entertainment uses to the former theater site, according to the Times.

Source: Laredo Morning Times, November 2026.
